theme: Skia m151 with managed perf wins
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and ports several hot P/Invoke paths to managed code.
highlights_body: Color and premultiply conversions, HarfBuzz buffer encoding, and tag parsing all move off native round-trips for lower overhead. It also fixes a native resource leak and a CPU raster regression.

bullets.detail: Brings the bundled Skia engine up to the m151 upstream release line, plus the ongoing chrome/m151 bug-fix merges throughout the preview cycle.

bullets.lead: Span overloads for hex color parsing
bullets.detail: SKColor hex parsing is optimized and gains ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for allocation-free parsing.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage fixed
bullets.detail: Fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI).
Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster rendering regression introduced by the engine update.

bullets.lead: Hot paths ported to managed code
bullets.detail: SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion, single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8, HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and SKShaper glyph reads now avoid P/Invoke round-trips and per-call allocations.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries built with the new exnref exception handling required by .NET 11.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM support for .NET 11 and bumped the Skia submodule to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 updated Skia to milestone m151 and began the WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 work.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the managed performance ports for color conversion, HarfBuzz buffer encoding, and tag parsing.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 fixed the SKImage native resource leak and the CPU raster regression ahead of the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free with a pooled UTF-8 encode and removes a per-call allocation from Tag.Parse.

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 Preview 1 updates to Skia m151.
v4.151.0-preview.1.1.body: It also starts adding Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM support for .NET 11.

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 Preview 2 ports several hot paths to managed code for lower overhead.
v4.151.0-preview.2.1.body: Color conversion, HarfBuzz buffer encoding, and tag parsing all move off native round-trips.

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 Release Candidate 1 fixes a native resource leak and a CPU raster regression.

v4.151.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ships the Skia m151 update with several managed performance improvements.
v4.151.0.body: It ports hot P/Invoke paths to managed code, fixes a resource leak and a raster regression, and adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM support for .NET 11.
